jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day The Supplier Quality & Development Organization is responsible for securing the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety. Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. Contract We are looking forward to your application via our online-portal https://karriere.frm2.tum.de until  26.11.2026.  Here you may also find other job vacancies at FRM II: https://karriere.frm2.tum.de   Technische Universität München Forschungsneutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) Personalbüro Lichtenbergstraße 1 D-85748 Garching Tel: +49 89 289 12305 oder 14910    www.mlz-garching.de www.frm2.tum.de   As part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.my-tum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and under-stood the data protection information (https://www.tum.de/spezialseiten/datenschutz/) provided by TUM.

previous Field Applications Scientist experience is not required.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.- Knowledge of relevant industry standards, regulations, and best practices.- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant scientific software.- Clear scientific and technical communication and presentation skills.- Ability to adapt to different customer profiles and needs.- Customer-focused mindset and strong interpersonal skills.- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams.- Good commercial insight and attitude.- Effective organization, prioritization, and time management skills.- Adaptability and willingness to learn.- Fluent German and professional proficiency in written and spoken English.- Valid driver's license.- Willingness to travel 50% - 75% or more.CompetenciesCustomer Focus, Scientific Expertise, Communication, Collaboration, Commercial Awareness, Problem Solving, Adaptability, and Continuous Learning.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: OperationsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.03.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026Stellennummer: MER0003ZHRArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOAs the FinTech hub of Mercedes‑Benz, we connect the world of mobility with the world of payments. Our mission is simple: Transform transactions into the best possible customer experience — inside the car and beyond.What does that mean in practice? We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement).ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz.We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore.Our solutions enable:- Digital Extras & subscriptions- Mobility services like fueling and charging- e-Commerce (ATC)- Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets)- In-car payments- LoyaltyOUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks.In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging.Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one!Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? Join us and help shape the future of payments!YOUR DAY AT GLANCE- You will collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where your experience and hands-on attitude are valued- You will set up and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure, align them with best-practice standards using infrastructure as code, and support the rollout of new payment products and services from an infrastructure perspective- You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments- You will further
